attributes.name: Arquebus
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8. You may additionally bury this card to add another 1d10. If you did not bury this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons; on 1-2, shuffle this card into your deck.

Discard this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by a character at another location.
